plugins.name: safedep-agent-skills
plugins.description: Makes AI agents fluent in SafeDep, which blocks malicious open source packages before they run on developer machines, AI coding agents, code repositories and CI/CD. Routes questions about PMG, vet, Gryph, xBom, the SafeDep MCP server, SafeDep Cloud and Threat Intel to safedep.io and docs.safedep.io, helps set them up, and runs endpoint investigations through the safedep CLI. Includes the SafeDep Docs MCP server.
